changelog: You stay signed in: your session renews itself, and changing your password no longer signs you out
Campaigns: Trigger, Pause, Resume and Delete now work just like on the web, including scheduled campaigns
Chats refresh by themselves when you come back to the app or your connection returns
The chat list loads more chats as you scroll
Image, video and document templates: upload your own file when you send - the sample file is never sent
Clearer error messages, and team members see only the screens they can use
